candidates.claim: OT-facing access port sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/6 is active in VLAN 20 (DMZ zone VLAN) instead of the required VLAN 10, which carries DMZ VLAN traffic onto the OT-facing side at layer 2.
candidates.remediation: Move sw-ot-01 Gi1/0/6 back to access VLAN 10 (or shut it down if it is not in use) and confirm no DMZ VLAN is present on OT-facing ports.

candidates.claim: The current configuration deviates from the approved baseline: sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/6 switchport access vlan changed from 10 in the baseline to 20 in the current snapshot.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile this change against the approved baseline and either revert it to VLAN 10 or document an approved exception.
